note: New at mint (2026-08-16, issue #379): owns canon-to-dependent DOCTRINE-drift conformance -- a rule stated canonically in one artifact violated/omitted/paraphrased by a dependent -- distinct from naming-audit's grammar axis, bloat-audit's busy-work axis, and pattern-audit's arbitrary caller-supplied sweep with no governed manifest. Fenced against attention-audit (menu-rent/collision, not doctrine conformance), overhaul-planning (this skill composes INTO its measure-first phase, never replaces it), estate-audit-agent (the batch dispatch form, owns no logic of its own), and make-script (a one-off check that should become a script, not a standing manifest edge). 2026-08-19 (issue #718): t06 was being stolen 2-of-3 by fix-old-names in the #676 sweep; description sharpened to name the vocab-term edge's own stale-tool-name/term trigger explicitly and add a reciprocal fence against fix-old-names' rename-wave-provenance handles. No case changes here -- fix-old-names' own evals gained the reciprocal n12 fence.
